title: Please add keyboard shortcuts to open new instances of applications in the task manager
line: Meta+Shift+1 through 9 now open a new window of the matching Task Manager app, or launch it if it is only pinned.
explanation: There was no shortcut to open a new instance of a Task Manager entry, only Meta+number to activate it. A plain Meta+Shift+number default could not work either: on Wayland KWin removes Shift from keys where it picks the symbol, so Meta+Shift+1 reached kglobalaccel as Meta+! and never matched (the reporter's 'shows as Meta+!' problem). KWin now retries a global shortcut that matched nothing with the unshifted key plus Shift, and the Task Manager's Backend registers 'Open New Instance of Task Manager Entry 1-10' (Meta+Shift+1..9 by default), dispatched to the same panel as Meta+number and handled like a middle click.

commits.message:
input: also match global shortcuts with Shift and the unshifted key

Shift+1 gives "!", so Meta+Shift+1 only reached shortcuts as Meta+! and
a shortcut set to Meta+Shift+1 never fired. When nothing is bound to the
shifted symbol, now also try the unshifted key with Shift held.

BUG: 444279

applets/taskmanager: add Meta+Shift+number shortcuts for new instances

Meta+number activates the Nth task, but there was no way to open another
window of it from the keyboard. Meta+Shift+1 through 9 now launch a new
instance of the Nth task or launcher, the same as middle-clicking it.
